description: Physically modelled djembe: a filtered noise burst driving five banks of resonant filters

params.text: Sets the level of the strike that excites the drum, which is a volume rather than the sharpness the label suggests
Sets how long the strike lasts, from a single-sample snap at the bottom to a longer knock at the top
Moves the two filter corners the strike noise passes through, changing the tone of the strike rather than its level

inputs.text: Raises the pitch one octave per volt; the voltage is clamped at 0V and 5V, so it covers five octaves upward and nothing below
Adds to the SHARPNESS knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total stops at full
Adds to the HIT knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total stops at full
Adds to the STRIKE AMT knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total stops at full
A rising edge strikes the drum

outputs.text: The drum sound, scaled to a 5V peak

notes: The number of voices follows the TRIGGER jack's channel count, up to four.
